questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: A display needs six identical cards followed by one footer. Which plan fits?
answers: Repeat the card six times, then draw the footer
Repeat the footer six times, then one card
Draw the footer inside each card
Draw one card and omit the footer
questions.explanation: Only the repeated card belongs inside the six-iteration loop.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: A setup command should run once before processing 9 records. Where should it go?
answers: At the end of every iteration
Only in the ninth record's data
questions.explanation: Setup outside the loop avoids repeating initialization.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: A loop starts a subtotal at zero on every iteration. Why can that lose earlier additions?
answers: Each iteration overwrites the accumulated subtotal
questions.explanation: Resetting the accumulator discards the previous running value.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: A printer repeats four batches of three labels. How many labels are produced?
questions.explanation: Four groups of three labels give twelve labels.
